teaser: RiskMandate's go-to-market plan: one workflow from an existing business rule to evidence that still holds after a change, starting with our own inbox.
core_idea: RiskMandate's go-to-market plan is to deliver one chain end to end, existing requirement, approved agent delegation, implemented control, observed result and evidence valid after change, packaged as a six-part delegation record, with human rules translated through an explicit approval, baselines never learned from behaviour, three stages that test value, maintenance and repeatability, and a first pilot on its own inbox, where Gmail cannot enforce draft-but-never-send.

nodes.label: The delegation record
nodes.summary: Six parts a customer can act on.

nodes.label: A people rule is not a delegation
